Frontend: public /events/evt_246d20a66b31 register modal verified (all 14 fields present with data-testid, 57-entry State/Territory list incl. Puerto Rico/Guam/USVI/American Samoa/N. Mariana, member Yes/No, categories General Admission+VIP, hidden honeypot input, BOTH opt-ins unchecked by default, client-side required validation toast, successful submit -> success state with confirmation number CEC-UJ54KJF2, website normalized server-side, only the checked opt-in created a consent, duplicate submit -> 400 toast 'You are already registered for this event'); /r/{conf}?t={token} manage page (event name/date/time/venue/category, attendee, Registered badge, QR image loads 330x330 from /api/public/qr, Cancel -> confirm -> status becomes Cancelled + 'This registration is cancelled', invalid token -> 'Registration not found'); portal Events -> manage-<eventId> -> Registrations tab (row with conf number + status, payment select with all 5 statuses, changing to Paid -> 'Payment updated' toast + persisted + confirmation attempt fired, resend-<regId> -> toast + resend_count 1). All TEST_ events/registrations/email_logs/consents deleted; both seeded events left Approved+published and registration count restored to 5.

minor.issue: Spam gate only reads the `honeypot` field. The frontend's honeypot input is named `company_website` and is remapped client-side, so a bot posting directly with `company_website` (the name visible in the DOM) is NOT blocked — Pydantic silently drops the extra key. Accept `company_website` as an alias too.

The confirmation email is awaited inline (send_registration_confirmation) instead of asyncio.create_task, so the admin's PUT blocks on the Resend round-trip (~1-2s observed). Register uses create_task; make this consistent.

A cancelled registration still returns a valid check-in QR (200) and the manage page keeps rendering it, so a cancelled attendee can present a scannable code. Consider 410/404 or a 'cancelled' overlay for status=='cancelled'.
No signature/secret verification — any caller can POST arbitrary email_ids and mutate email_log/registration confirmation_status. Add Svix/Resend signature validation before Phase B.

ui_bugs.issue: Resend always shows a green success toast built from the send status, producing the contradictory toast 'Confirmation failed' styled as success. Use toast.error when data.status is failed/bounced.
Uses native window.confirm() instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere; also means automated/e2e cancellation needs a dialog handler. Functionality itself works.
Modal DialogContent has no Description/aria-describedby (React a11y warning logged twice on open).
Optional-details grid leaves ZIP code alone on its own row (odd field count in a 2-col grid) and the required-field validation only surfaces one toast at a time with no inline field highlighting.

issues: The check-in QR card remains fully visible and un-dimmed after cancelling, next to 'This registration is cancelled' — visually contradictory
'1 / 50 registered' counter is not reduced/refreshed after a cancellation until page reload (cosmetic, count comes from the public event payload)

action_items: EventManage.jsx: use toast.error for failed/bounced resend results instead of a green 'Confirmation failed' success toast.
Accept `company_website` as an alias of `honeypot` in RegistrationIn so the DOM-visible honeypot name actually blocks bots.
Fire the payment-triggered confirmation with asyncio.create_task (or a background task) so PUT /registrations/{id}/payment doesn't block on Resend.
Invalidate/hide the QR + gate /api/public/qr for cancelled registrations.
Add Resend webhook signature verification before relying on /api/webhooks/resend in production.
Optional polish: replace window.confirm in ManageRegistration with shadcn AlertDialog; add DialogDescription to the register modal.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1988 lines — the events/registrations/email block (lines ~900-1450) should be extracted into its own router module; it is the single largest maintenance risk in the codebase.
Good: every public read/register path goes through _public_evq, QR is generated from checkin_token only (no PII), all responses project {_id:0}, and PAYMENT_STATUSES is validated server-side.
send_registration_confirmation's confirmation_sent guard correctly makes the paid->confirmed transition idempotent (verified: repeat 'paid' produced no second email).
log_and_send swallows provider exceptions into status='failed' with error text and never raises — good, registration is never lost because of an email failure.
update_registration_payment does not append to payment_history when the value is unchanged (from==to), which pollutes history with no-op entries; consider skipping identical transitions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the three requested flows work end-to-end (issues found are toast semantics / a11y / polish)

The suite is self-cleaning (session-scoped Mongo teardown keyed on a per-run TAG) and safe to re-run; it creates its own paid/no-cancel TEST_PhaseA events. delivered+<TAG>@resend.dev returns status 'sent' with a provider_id, so real send verification is possible. The round-7 bug (un-check-in clobbers 'waitlist' status) was NOT re-tested this round.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in Phase A. The only misleading behaviour is cosmetic: EventManage.resendConf pipes the send status into toast.success, so a sandbox-rejected recipient renders a green toast reading 'Confirmation failed'. The initially observed 'cancel does nothing' on /r/{conf} was a test artifact — cancel() is gated by window.confirm(), which Playwright auto-dismisses; with a dialog handler the cancel succeeded and the status flipped to Cancelled.
